title: RADIO AM/FM-IGNITION SHIELDING EQUIPMENT
summary: Radio-option (U69 AM/FM) ignition shielding for the 454 engines (RPO LS5 & LS7): the shielded spark plug wire set (one wire per cylinder, separate part numbers for LS7) running from the distributor cap to the plugs. Each wire's shielding has a ground lead ending in an eyelet; the eyelets of neighbouring wires are stacked and bolted to the cylinder heads, and ground leads at the distributor are held by a nut. View A gives the plug wire routing / firing order at the cap.

fastening.to: cylinder heads (each side of the engine)
fastening.note: Bolt [10] goes through the stacked ground-lead eyelets of two adjacent plug wires into a boss on the cylinder head, one bolt per pair of wires (lower view: wires 8+6 at one bolt, 4+2 at the other; the other bank is drawn the same way at upper right). The ground leads are part of each wire assembly; no separate strap.
Nut [9] goes down onto a stud at the distributor, beside the cap, clamping wire ground lead(s). Which leads/stud exactly is not clear in the drawing.

notes: VIEW A: plug wire routing from distributor cap terminals to cylinders 1-8 (odd numbers RH bank, even numbers LH bank).
